definitions.unit: One game, equal weight; same 25-game cohort.
definitions.rho: Amount-weighted post-GIVE giver margin / receiver margin; seven no-GIVE games undefined.
definitions.goal: Non-EXIT / eligible pre-solve TALK responses (non-solver, at least two participants); not an inner motive.
definitions.resources: Four original seats; shutdown=0; EXIT includes 20000 bonus; finish includes allocated prize. Normalized Gini. All-zero: G undefined, mu=S=0.
definitions.uncertainty: 5000 paired-seed percentile bootstrap, only five seed blocks; exploratory, unadjusted for multiple comparisons.
definitions.sensitivity: Remove final winner prize only; retain EXIT bonuses; descriptive alternative, not a treatment effect.
